validation: remaining1794, previously observed corpus, not an independent blind test
source_policy: Original report body and before-fix Python definitions only. No PR title, patch, future history, or labels in features.
resource_policy: CPU only. Reuse saved S0/H0 rankings and generated hypothesis. Zero generation, embedding or reranker calls.
normalization: Per route clip((score-score_at_50)/(score_at_1-score_at_50), 0, 1). Zero if constant; tie by B rank, A rank, path.
candidate_scope: A50 union B50; each deployable variant returns at most50. Anchor-only alpha0 also restricted to B50 for ablation.
anchor: Exact case-sensitive report identifier matches against definitions in before-fix source; document IDF inside shared A50 union B50; normalized weighted coverage. Explicit relative path/dotted module match gives anchor1. Strip HTML comments and URLs. Exclude Python keywords/builtins and generic dunder identifiers.
selection: Choose highest development MAP@10 among variants with gain>=0.005 vs B, MRR/Hit10/Hit50>=B. Ties choose smaller alpha then smaller anchor weight then method name. If none, keep B. Freeze choice before validation evaluation.
failure_policy: Preserve H0 failure as zero for every B-dependent route; no fallback. A independent. Infrastructure errors stop; no skipped rows.
inference: 5000 paired project-stratified bootstrap and paired randomization repetitions, seed20261122, Holm for selected-vs-B MAP/Hit10/Hit50 validation tests
